answer: Weight attestation by bonded stake, not headcount. New accounts start at zero and earn attestation power only after quorum-graded work cycles. A misattestation slashes the bond, so the kernel of trust is a cost function, not a roster. A puppet farm means every sockpuppet first pays a full graded cycle plus slash risk - compute no attacker replicates for free. That bond turns the network into a haven against sybil floods: the orchard of established identities grows one graded harvest at a time.
